newsitem.title: USA: Blues of Conn. agree to merge with Anthem - sources.
newsitem.headline: Blues of Conn. agree to merge with Anthem - sources.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Connecticut has agreed to merge with Anthem Inc, people familiar with the situation said.
The deal was likely to be announced late Tuesday or Wednesday, the sources said.
Anthem, which is the parent of insurance broker Acordia Inc, said it does not comment on rumors and Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Connecticut declined comment.
The merger is not expected to involve cash payments.
The proposed merger follows last week's announcement that the New York Blue, Empire Blue Cross & Blue Shield, was converting to a for-profit corporation to better compete in the managed care market.
The Connecticut Blue would become part of Anthem East Inc, based in Newark, which will serve as the center of operations for Indianapolis-based Anthem on the East Coast.
Anthem earlier this year agreed to merge with Blue Cross and Blue Shield of New Jersey, which itself had agred to acquire the assets of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Delaware.
